top_choice_rationale: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles turn a clear molecular design principle (pH-tuned headgroup charge, lipid polymorphism, rapid-mixing self-assembly) into delivery of nucleic acids, validated in approved siRNA therapy and mRNA vaccines and reproduced widely. The Cullis-Hope-Madden cut follows the mechanism and keeps the citation distinct from the 2023 Medicine prize; the exclusion of Langer, Anderson and MacLachlan is the main weakness. Perovskites follow for a traceable trio but unresolved stability, then sequencing chemistry, C-N coupling and Car-Parrinello; no award is last.
